title: The Download: our 35 Innovators Under 35 this year
summary: MIT Technology Review's 2026 Innovators Under 35 list highlights emerging leaders shaping the future of science and technology. The annual selection offers a window into the innovations and breakthroughs the next generation will drive.
content: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. title: This founder is teaching chips how to recycle (their energy)
summary: Hannah Earley's startup Vaire Computing is developing chips that recycle waste heat through reversible computing, challenging the assumption that energy loss is inevitable. This approach could significantly improve efficiency and reduce power consumption in computing.
content: Throughout the history of the computer chip, engineers have treated waste heat as an inevitable cost of a calculation. Hannah Earley, however, thinks it’s a design choice. Earley, 31, is cofounder and chief technology officer of Vaire Computing, a startup building chips that recycle energy usually thrown away as heat—a strategy known as reversible computing.…

zh.title: 这位创始人正在教芯片如何回收（它们的能量）
zh.summary: Hannah Earley的初创公司Vaire Computing正在开发通过可逆计算来回收废热的芯片，挑战了能量损耗是必然的假设。这种方法可以显著提高效率并减少计算中的功耗。

title: This AI entrepreneur is developing agents that can plan ahead for the unexpected
summary: AI entrepreneur Danijar Hafner's stealth-mode startup is building intelligent agents capable of planning ahead for unexpected scenarios. The technology aims to advance autonomous systems' ability to handle real-world uncertainties and adapt dynamically.
content: Danijar Hafner’s office in San Francisco’s SoMa district sits mostly empty. His brand-new startup is still in stealth mode and doesn’t even have its name on the door. zh.summary: 人工智能企业家Danijar Hafner的隐形创业公司正在开发能够为意外情况提前规划的智能代理。该技术旨在推进自主系统处理真实世界不确定性和动态适应的能力。

title: This founder is making cheaper, cleaner steel
summary: A founder is transforming steel production with cheaper and cleaner methods, disrupting an industry that has changed little since the 1850s. The innovation addresses both economic and environmental pressures of traditional blast-furnace steelmaking.
content: The steel industry isn’t exactly known for innovation. Very little has changed about purifying iron ore since the process was invented and commercialized in the 1850s. zh.title: 这位创始人正在生产更便宜、更清洁的钢铁
zh.summary: 一位创始人正在通过更便宜、更清洁的方法改变钢铁生产，打破了自1850年代以来鲜有变化的行业格局。这项创新解决了传统高炉炼钢的经济和环保压力。

title: This geneticist’s age-reversal tech could help restore sight
summary: Geneticist Ryan Lu is developing age-reversal technology to restore vision lost to age-related blindness, motivated by his family's experience with degenerative eye diseases. His research at Whitehead Institute applies aging science to potentially reverse sight loss.
content: Yuancheng (Ryan) Lu is obsessed with aging. And with eyes. As he steps outside the Whitehead Institute in Cambridge, Massachusetts, his aviator glasses darken automatically in the sun. zh.title: 这位遗传学家的逆衰老技术可能帮助恢复视力
zh.summary: 遗传学家Ryan Lu正在开发逆衰老技术，以恢复因年龄相关失明而丧失的视力，他的研究受到家族退行性眼病经历的激励。他在怀特海德研究所的研究将衰老科学应用于可能逆转视力丧失的领域。
